headline: Indian equities fall as surging crude oil prices and West Asia tensions weigh on market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices rising up to USD 114 weigh heavily on Indian market sentiment.
Escalating West Asia tensions drive geopolitical uncertainty and global market volatility.
Broad-based sell-off across key sectoral indices pushing Nifty and Sensex to lower levels.
Indian Rupee declined by 12 paise to close at 94.93 against the U.S. dollar.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed off high levels and Nifty slipped below key technical thresholds during the session.
SBI Cards reported a strong Q2 profit surge of 75% to Rs 778 crore, beating earnings estimates.
Tata Motors commercial vehicle arm returned to profitability with Rs 2,138 crore net profit.
Infosys announced an interim dividend of Rs 26 per share for its shareholders.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed lower amidst surging crude oil prices and heightened West Asia tensions. On the corporate front, strong earnings from SBI Cards and Tata Motors alongside an Infosys dividend announcement offered positive stock-specific action. Overall market sentiment remained under pressure due to persistent macroeconomic and geopolitical concerns.
